_note: Title screen animation. Times in milliseconds.

hold_scroll._note: Holding a direction: auto-repeat starts after delay_ms, then steps every repeat_ms (the menu and the player selector).

menu_scroll._note: The menu eases toward the chosen box by exponential smoothing (45 ms: a half-life of about 31 ms, about 120 ms to arrive), and snaps once within snap_distance boxes.

locked_static._note: The locked vault entry flickers: every check_interval_ms a burst starts with a chance of chance in chance_out_of (2 in 10: about 2 bursts a second), lasting burst_min_ms to burst_max_ms.

player_select._note: The open timeline: the upper band lands at upper_land_ms; the lower one enters at lower_in_ms and lands at lower_land_ms. The selected box starts popping in at pop_at_ms, each box further out pop_step_ms later, each pop taking pop_ms. Decide is refused before decide_lock_ms; the decide confirm lasts decide_ms, the cancel outro close_ms (the prompt fades out over its first outro_fade_ms). The dim fades in over dim_in_ms.

band._note: The bands scroll at scroll_px_per_s, building up over build_up_ms once both have landed, rushing up to scroll_px_per_s + rush_px_per_s while deciding. After a count change the previous ribbons fade out over swap_fade_ms. On cancel the bands slide close_travel_px off over close_ms.

prompt._note: The prompt fades in from delay_ms over fade_ms, sliding from start_offset_px (vertical) to its place.

carousel._note: The carousel eases toward the selection by exponential smoothing and snaps once within snap_distance boxes.

box._note: The selected box bobs by bob_px every bob_period_ms. Deciding pulses it by decide_pulse (scale) while the others fade by decide_others_fade over decide_others_fade_ms. On cancel the boxes shrink by close_shrink and fade out over close_ms.

bounce._note: A selection change bounces the box's art for ms: by press_amount on a press, hold_amount on a hold-repeat step (scale).

ring._note: The selection ring fades in over fade_in_ms once its box has popped, then pulses between pulse_base and pulse_base + pulse_range opacity every pulse_period_ms; deciding flashes it for flash_ms.
